findings.highlight: I don’t look back as I jump.
findings.evidenceJa: 後ろを見ずに、勘だけで跳び退いた。
findings.governingReading: Without looking back, Shirou relies purely on intuition and leaps backward.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the intuition guiding the move and its backward direction, weakening his embodied danger sense and exact evasion.

findings.highlight: I use the corner of the hallway as a shield and jump sideways with all my might!
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の死角、廊下の曲がり角を盾にして、ともかく全力で横っ跳びする！
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses the corridor corner as a shield specifically because it is Rin’s blind spot, then dives sideways at full force.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the corner and movement but omits that Shirou has identified and entered Rin’s blind spot.

findings.highlight: I hear Tohsaka cluck her tongue as something heavy hits the wall.
findings.evidenceJa: 苛だたしげな遠坂の舌打ちと、何か重い物が壁を乱打する音が聞こえた。
findings.governingReading: Shirou hears Rin click her tongue irritably while something heavy batters the wall repeatedly.
findings.explanation: The English drops Rin’s visible irritation and reduces 乱打’s repeated violent impacts to a single generic hit.

findings.highlight: It’s a projectile weapon[line4]no, that thing is a “curse” that’ll infect the target with a disease.
findings.evidenceJa: 飛び道具[line4]いや、ありゃ狙った相手を病気にするっていう“呪い”めいた物だ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou corrects himself: it is a curse-like thing that makes its chosen target ill.
findings.explanation: “Infect ... with a disease” is malformed and changes supernatural illness infliction into transmission of an infection.

findings.highlight: The Gandr Shot Tohsaka was talking about should be something from the Northern European rune
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が言っていたガンド撃ちってのは、たしか北欧のルーン魔術に含まれる物で
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls that Gandr belongs to Northern European rune magecraft.
findings.explanation: “Something from the Northern European rune” is incomplete and drops the magecraft category, damaging the system explanation.

findings.highlight: an indirect curse that worsens the disease of the one being pointed at.
findings.evidenceJa: 相手を指差す事で病状を悪化させる間接的な呪いの筈だ。
findings.governingReading: It should be an indirect curse that worsens the target’s pathological condition by pointing at them.
findings.explanation: The English makes “the disease” a specific pre-existing object rather than describing an induced worsening of the target’s condition, and renders the sentence unnaturally.

findings.highlight: it shouldn’t be something with any physical effect.
findings.evidenceJa: 間違ってもあんな風に、直接ドカーッと効果の出るもんじゃない。
findings.governingReading: Ordinary Gandr should never produce an immediate, direct, explosive impact like the one Shirou just saw.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the contrast into absence of any physical effect, losing the directness and explosive immediacy that distinguish Rin’s Gandr.

findings.highlight: The problem is, its power is like that of a bullet as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 問題は外見だけでなく、威力も効果も弾丸と同じだってコトだ。
findings.governingReading: The problem is that not only its appearance but both its force and effect are the same as a bullet’s.
findings.explanation: The English preserves bullet-like power but omits the separate claim that its effect too has become bullet-equivalent.

findings.highlight: I instantly get myself together.
findings.evidenceJa: 全速で体勢を立て直す。
findings.governingReading: Shirou restores his physical stance at full speed.
findings.explanation: The English changes maximum-speed bodily recovery into an instantaneous and potentially mental act.

findings.highlight: I have to run for now…!
findings.evidenceJa: 今はとにかく逃げないとシャレにならない……！
findings.governingReading: Unless Shirou escapes now, the situation will be no joke: the danger is intolerably real.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the need to run but omits the idiom marking the consequences as deadly serious.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka sprints out from the corner.
findings.evidenceJa: 階段から躍り出てくる遠坂。
findings.governingReading: Rin bounds out from the stairway.
findings.explanation: The English moves Rin’s emergence from the stairs to an unspecified corner, breaking the chase geometry established on the preceding pages.

findings.highlight: It seems she shot it right after she ran into the hallway…!
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のやつ、廊下にでるなり問答無用でぶっ放しやがったらしい……！
findings.governingReading: The instant Rin emerged into the hallway, she apparently fired without question or warning.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the timing but omits 問答無用 and Shirou’s aggrieved account of her indiscriminate, no-warning attack.

findings.highlight: The bullets go through the walls, hitting everything in the classroom.
findings.evidenceJa: 弾丸は壁を貫通し、放射状に教室内を狙い撃ちにする。
findings.governingReading: The shots pierce the wall and deliberately rake the classroom in a radial pattern.
findings.explanation: “Hitting everything” removes both the radial spread and 狙い撃ち’s directed targeting, blurring Rin’s attack pattern.

findings.highlight: No way! Why are you still standing!?
findings.evidenceJa: うそ、なんでピンシャンしてんのよアンタは！
findings.governingReading: Rin is astonished that Shirou remains completely hale and lively.
findings.explanation: “Still standing” narrows ピンシャン to posture and can imply mere endurance, omitting her surprise at his apparently robust condition.

findings.highlight: We’re about four meters apart, in the front and in the back of the classroom.
findings.evidenceJa: 距離は四メートルほど、俺たちは教室の前と後ろの入り口に手をかけて
findings.governingReading: About four metres apart, Shirou and Rin each have a hand on the classroom’s front and rear entrances.
findings.explanation: The English keeps approximate distance but replaces their hands-on opposing exits with vague positions in the front and back of the room.

findings.highlight: It just scraped my head! Hey, it scraped my sides as well!
findings.evidenceJa: こめかみに掠っていったぞ、今！　ちょっ、脇腹、脇腹にいまじーんときたじーんと！
findings.governingReading: A shot has just grazed Shirou’s temple, and another leaves a penetrating, lingering sensation in his flank.
findings.explanation: The English broadens temple to head, pluralizes the flank, and replaces the repeated じーん bodily sensation with another simple scrape.

findings.highlight: Stop if you don’t want to get hurt! I’ll finish you off quickly if you do stop!
findings.evidenceJa: 痛いのがイヤなら止まりなさい、そしたらすぐ楽にしてあげるから！
findings.governingReading: Rin orders Shirou to stop and promises to put him at ease quickly if he surrenders.
findings.explanation: “Finish you off” conventionally threatens to kill him, adding an explicit lethal intent absent from Rin’s coercive but deliberately ambiguous 楽にしてあげる.

findings.highlight: Actually, the sounds are like those of real bullets!
findings.evidenceJa: というか、なぜにさっきから効果音がリアル銃弾になってますか！？
findings.governingReading: Shirou comically asks why the sound effects have literally turned into real bullets.
findings.explanation: The English drops the incredulous question and the self-aware “sound effects” phrasing, reducing the joke to a comparison.

findings.highlight: I’m getting irritated because my target’s moving…!
findings.evidenceJa: 標的が動きまわるから、狙いに熱が入るんじゃない……！
findings.governingReading: Rin blames the moving target for making her get carried away or put increasing heat into her aim.
findings.explanation: The English replaces her escalating enthusiasm or intensity in aiming with irritation, changing the comic responsibility shift and her combat temperament.

findings.highlight: “Man! This is like giving a knife to[line3]!”[lr]
findings.evidenceJa: 「うわーっ！　これじゃなんとかに刃物だーっ！」[lr]
findings.governingReading: This incomplete “something with a knife” exchange is semicolon-commented inactive material in the original Japanese.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally activates obsolete dialogue absent from the authoritative running script, and the restored proverb is itself left incomplete in English.

findings.highlight: I run down the stairs and reach the landing.
findings.evidenceJa: 階段を駆け下りて、二階の踊り場に着く。
findings.governingReading: Shirou runs down to the landing on the second floor.
findings.explanation: The English omits the floor, weakening the repeated floor-by-floor chase geometry.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka shouldn’t be able follow me if I make it to the first [r]floor
findings.evidenceJa: いくら遠坂でもこんな無茶はしな
findings.governingReading: Shirou assumes that even Rin will not continue such reckless conduct once he reaches the first floor.
findings.explanation: The English changes a judgment about the limit of Rin’s reckless public attack into a claim that she physically cannot follow him.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka took a shortcut by jumping over the railing of the stairs.
findings.evidenceJa: 一階に続く階段まで一気にショートカットしやがった。
findings.governingReading: By vaulting the railing, Rin shortcuts directly to the stairway continuing down to the first floor.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the shortcut but omits its destination, obscuring how Rin cuts Shirou off below.

findings.highlight: You’re pretty agile. I thought you said you had flab.
findings.evidenceJa: 身体、軽いんだな遠坂。前は贅肉があるとか言ってたのに
findings.governingReading: Shirou remarks that Rin’s body is light despite her earlier claim about excess flesh.
findings.explanation: “Agile” conveys athleticism but breaks the light-body versus extra-weight word chain that makes the callback provocative.

findings.highlight: Some veins are showing in Tohsaka’s forehead now.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂、青筋たてて睨んできた。
findings.governingReading: Rin glares at Shirou with an anger vein standing out.
findings.explanation: The English retains the vein but omits her directed glare, turning an active hostile reaction into a static appearance.

findings.highlight: The instant I realize it’s coming, I jump sideways and hear the bullets hit the wall beside me.
findings.evidenceJa: 来るな、と思った瞬間、足は勝手に廊下へと横っ跳びして、だんだん、と壁に炸裂する銃弾の音を聞いていた。
findings.governingReading: The instant Shirou anticipates the shot, his legs move on their own into a sideways corridor leap as repeated impacts burst against the wall.
findings.explanation: The English makes the evasion consciously agentive and removes both his automatic bodily response and the repeated impact rhythm.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s Gandr Shots are loud enough now that it’ll have people calling the cops.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のガンドは、これ以上やったら間違いなく警察に通報されるレベルにまでアップしている。
findings.governingReading: Rin’s Gandr has escalated to a level where continuing will certainly prompt a police report.
findings.explanation: The English invents loudness as the sole cause, narrowing a judgment about the attack’s overall conspicuous and destructive escalation.

findings.highlight: is now burning everything it touches.
findings.evidenceJa: 触れた箇所をごっそりと焼き削る物となっている。
findings.governingReading: The enlarged curse now burns and gouges away a substantial portion of whatever area it touches.
findings.explanation: “Burning everything” omits the removal of material and ごっそり’s severity, weakening the new bodily danger.

findings.highlight: The Gandr Shot scrapes my leg.
findings.evidenceJa: 片足。腿にガンドが触れる。
findings.governingReading: A Gandr shot touches the thigh of one leg.
findings.explanation: The English broadens thigh to leg and adds a scraping motion, losing the precise contact that slows Shirou.

findings.highlight: I jump into the room beside me.
findings.evidenceJa: 体は真横、三年の教室に飛び込んでいた。
findings.governingReading: Before deliberation can catch up, Shirou’s body has already thrown itself directly sideways into a third-year classroom.
findings.explanation: The English makes the move a simple conscious action and omits both bodily automaticity and the classroom’s year.

findings.highlight: “Das Schlie[szlig]en. Vogelk[auml]fig, Echo.”
findings.evidenceJa: 「Das Sch[ruby text="　　　準"]l[ruby text="　　　備"]i[ruby text="　　　。"]e[szlig]en.[ruby text="　　　防"]V[ruby text="　　　音"]o[ruby text="　　　、"]gelk[auml]f[ruby text="終　　"]i[ruby text="　　了"]g,Echo」
findings.governingReading: The incantation presents German phonetics together with written Japanese meanings: preparation, soundproofing, completion.
findings.explanation: The English retains only the phonetic layer and omits the written semantic sequence that tells the reader what the barrier is doing.

findings.highlight: I jump to the wall.
findings.evidenceJa: 窓際に頭から飛び込む。
findings.governingReading: Shirou dives headfirst toward the window side.
findings.explanation: The English changes both destination and manner, moving him to a wall and deleting the headfirst dive that sets up his defensive position.

findings.highlight: I feel a strong magic being activated.
findings.evidenceJa: 強い魔術の発動を全身で感じ取る。
findings.governingReading: Shirou senses the activation of powerful magecraft throughout his entire body.
findings.explanation: The English collapses 魔術 to “magic” and its construction makes the technical activation sound like an individual magic object.

findings.highlight: I close my eyes and place my hand on the desk.
findings.evidenceJa: 手のひらを机の裏側に密着させる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou presses his palm tightly against the underside of the desk.
findings.explanation: The English removes the palm, underside, and close contact required for his rushed Strengthening attempt.

findings.highlight: I skip every manufacturing process, the process of making another nerve in my spine, and pour all my frantically pour magical energy into the desk…!
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる工程、背骨に第二の神経を作る過程を吹っ飛ばして、机にありったけの魔力を流し込む……！
findings.governingReading: Shirou blows past every procedural step, including creating a second nerve in his spine, and pours all available magical energy into the desk.
findings.explanation: The English invents “manufacturing,” weakens “second nerve” to another nerve, and exposes mutually competing revision fragments in the finished sentence.

findings.highlight: “Fixierung, Eile Salve!”
findings.evidenceJa: 「Fix[ruby text=狙]i[ruby text=え]e[ruby text=、]rung,Ei[ruby text=一]l[ruby text=斉]e[ruby text=射]S[ruby text=撃]alve！」
findings.governingReading: The German incantation is overlaid with written commands meaning “Aim, volley fire.”
findings.explanation: The English prints only the phonetic German and discards the written command layer.

findings.highlight: “Trace, on!”
findings.evidenceJa: 「[ruby text=トレース char=2]同調、[ruby text=オン o2o=1]開始！」
findings.governingReading: The line simultaneously reads written “Synchronization, start” and ruby “Trace, on.”
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the ruby reading and removes the written meanings that define Shirou’s activation formula.

findings.highlight: As it has mass, it destroys everything it touches.
findings.evidenceJa: 質量を持ったソレは、触れる物全てを弾き飛ばしていく。
findings.governingReading: The mass-bearing magical energy knocks away everything it touches.
findings.explanation: “Destroys” replaces the stated mass-driven knockback mechanism with indiscriminate destruction.

findings.highlight: The desks are running crazy like a person on fire.
findings.evidenceJa: 机は、頭に火をつけられた人間のように荒れ狂う。
findings.governingReading: The desks thrash like people whose heads have been set on fire.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the specifically grotesque head-fire image to a person generally on fire and renders 荒れ狂う weakly.

findings.highlight: The bullets fired in here are no exception, as the sounds don’t escape this room.
findings.evidenceJa: 放たれる何十という弾丸も例外ではなく、この騒音さえ外には漏れない。
findings.governingReading: The dozens of fired projectiles are likewise confined, and even the noise cannot leak outside.
findings.explanation: The English omits the quantity and makes “no exception” depend awkwardly on the noise clause, leaving the projectiles’ inability to exit unclear.

findings.highlight: she’s still acting like a magus!
findings.evidenceJa: 感心するぐらい魔術師然としてるじゃないか！
findings.governingReading: Despite seeming enraged, Rin is conducting herself so thoroughly like a magus that Shirou is impressed.
findings.explanation: The English retains her magus-like conduct but omits Shirou’s explicit admiration for her control and preparation.

findings.highlight: I strengthen the desk to defend myself against this rain of magical energy.
findings.evidenceJa: “強化”によって硬度を増した机は、豪雨じみた魔力の弾丸を防いでいた。
findings.governingReading: The desk, its hardness increased through Strengthening, is successfully blocking the torrential rain of magical shots.
findings.explanation: The English removes increased hardness and rewrites an observed defensive result as Shirou’s purpose, weakening what Strengthening physically accomplishes.

findings.highlight: My strengthening magic will only endure this barrage of bullets for about three seconds.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の強化では、この弾丸の雨を三秒と防げない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s Strengthening cannot hold the barrage for even three seconds.
findings.explanation: “About three seconds” overstates the duration and reverses 三秒と…ない’s strict upper bound.

findings.highlight: and repeat this process
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の続く限り繰り返すしかないのだが
findings.governingReading: He has no option but to reapply Strengthening every time it expires for as long as his magical energy lasts.
findings.explanation: The English states repetition but omits its governing resource limit, which explains the imminent loss.

findings.highlight: I can’t do anything if my magical energy runs out.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力が底をついたのではどうしようもない。
findings.governingReading: There is nothing Shirou can do now that his magical energy has bottomed out.
findings.explanation: The English changes the present cause of defeat into a hypothetical future condition.

findings.highlight: I hear a sound.
findings.evidenceJa: からん、という音。
findings.governingReading: A light metallic clatter rings out.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the sound’s concrete metallic quality, weakening the discovery of the iron chair leg.

findings.highlight: I pick up the stick
findings.evidenceJa: 二十センチほどの鉄の棒を握って
findings.governingReading: Shirou grips the roughly twenty-centimetre iron rod from the chair.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the measured iron object to a generic stick, obscuring the material and scale he Strengthens as a weapon.

findings.highlight: Wow, I’m perfect when it really counts.
findings.evidenceJa: なんだ、本番なら百発百中じゃないか、俺
findings.governingReading: Shirou boasts that in a real attempt he is now succeeding one hundred times out of one hundred.
findings.explanation: “Perfect” removes the quantified reliability claim and its practice-versus-real-attempt contrast.

findings.highlight: I’ll be dead if she attacks again.
findings.evidenceJa: もう一度さっきのをやられたら間違いなく蜂の巣にされる。
findings.governingReading: If Rin repeats the barrage, Shirou will certainly be riddled with holes like a beehive.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the concrete predicted bodily result with generic death, losing the image tied to the machine-gun comparison.

findings.highlight: I glare at her and manage to stand up.
findings.evidenceJa: なんとか中腰まで立ち上がる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou manages to rise only as far as a half-crouch.
findings.explanation: The English makes him fully standing, overstating recovery from the numbness and magical exhaustion.

findings.highlight: But it’s not like running would do me any good.
findings.evidenceJa: それでどうにかなる話でもない。
findings.governingReading: Even that limited ability to move will not resolve his predicament.
findings.explanation: The English invents running as the failed option and narrows a general assessment of his helplessness.

findings.highlight: I’m sure she’ll shoot me down without hesitation.
findings.evidenceJa: 今度こそ避ける間もなく撃ち抜かれるだろう。
findings.governingReading: If combat resumes, this time Shirou will be shot through before he has any time to evade.
findings.explanation: “Without hesitation” assigns the limitation to Rin’s mental state instead of Shirou’s lack of time to dodge.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka declares her victory.
findings.evidenceJa: ふふん、と勝ち誇る遠坂凛。
findings.governingReading: Rin gloats triumphantly with a smug “hmph.”
findings.explanation: The English communicates victory but removes the smug vocal gesture that characterizes her performance of superiority.

findings.highlight: I raise the leg of the chair
findings.evidenceJa: 椅子の脚を遠坂に突きつける。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thrusts the chair leg directly toward Rin as his declaration of total resistance.
findings.explanation: The English changes a confrontational point or thrust at Rin into merely raising the improvised weapon.

findings.highlight: I won’t forgive you for this even if you apologize.
findings.evidenceJa: いまさら謝られてもこの恨みは忘れないぞ
findings.governingReading: Even an apology this late will not make Shirou forget this grudge.
findings.explanation: The English replaces his comic insistence on remembering the grudge with the more morally absolute refusal to forgive and omits “this late.”

findings.highlight: I guess that made her really serious. I finally realize that I’m in a hopeless situation…!
findings.evidenceJa: 今ので本当に最後のスイッチを入れてしまったというか、自分がまな板の上の鯉だってようやく気が付いた……！
findings.governingReading: Her last statement feels as though it has thrown the final switch, and Shirou finally realizes he is a carp laid helpless on the cutting board.
findings.explanation: The English compresses both the irreversible final-switch image and the culturally concrete image of total helplessness into generic seriousness and hopelessness.

findings.highlight: If you said something absent-minded even in a situation like this, I would’ve done something.
findings.evidenceJa: これだけ言ってまだぼんやりしたコト吐かれたら、それこそどうかしてたから、わたし
findings.governingReading: If Shirou still said something vague after all that, then Rin herself would truly have lost it or become unhinged.
findings.explanation: “I would’ve done something” turns a statement about Rin’s own mental limit into an unspecified threatened action.

findings.highlight: give me your Command Spell.
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪を出しなさい。
findings.governingReading: Rin orders Shirou to expose or present his Command Spell so she can remove it.
findings.explanation: “Give me” makes the spell sound directly transferable and preempts the following distinction between showing the mark and handing over an object.

findings.highlight: It’ll rip off the nerves in your arm in the worst case
findings.evidenceJa: 最悪腕の神経を剥がす事になるけど
findings.governingReading: At worst, removing the Command Spell may result in stripping the nerves from his arm.
findings.explanation: The English’s declarative “it’ll” makes the nerve damage certain even while retaining the contradictory worst-case phrase.

findings.highlight: Give up my Command Spell?
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪を差し出す……？
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders about holding out or presenting his Command Spell.
findings.explanation: “Give up” changes the physical/procedural question into surrendering possession or rights, reinforcing the false transfer model.

findings.highlight: I[line3][lr]
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はこのまま、
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s interrupted choice begins “If I remain like this…” or “As things stand, I…”.
findings.explanation: The English leaves only a bare “I,” omitting このまま and therefore the condition framing the branch decision.

findings.highlight: I hear her running after me.
findings.evidenceJa: 背後から駆け下りてくる足音が響く。
findings.governingReading: Footsteps echo from behind as Rin runs down the stairs.
findings.explanation: The English preserves pursuit but removes her downward stair movement, weakening the chase geometry.

findings.highlight: Isn’t there a shield, an armor, or a bulletproof vest in here..!?
findings.evidenceJa: 盾とか服とか防弾チョッキとかないか……！？
findings.governingReading: Shirou desperately searches for a shield, protective clothing, or a bulletproof vest.
findings.explanation: The English replaces ordinary clothes with armor, changing the desperate and intentionally implausible classroom inventory.

findings.highlight: No way. Am I an idiot[line4]!?
findings.evidenceJa: なワケあるか、バカ[line4]！
findings.governingReading: Shirou immediately rebukes himself: “As if, idiot!”
findings.explanation: The English turns the decisive self-directed insult into a literal question about whether he is an idiot.

findings.highlight: Of course not…![lr]
findings.evidenceJa: 当然、タダで済むほど甘くないわ……！
findings.governingReading: Rin warns that naturally the attack is not so mild that he will get off without paying a price.
findings.explanation: “Of course not” deletes the entire consequence and severity clause from her threat.

findings.highlight: The sound of firing echoes in the hallway.[lr]
findings.evidenceJa: 一際強く銃声が木霊する。
findings.governingReading: One exceptionally loud or powerful gunshot reverberates through the hall.
findings.explanation: The English removes the singled-out shot’s exceptional intensity and reduces gunshot to generic firing.

findings.highlight: I reach the stairs in the nick of time.
findings.evidenceJa: 二年Ａ組側の階段に辿り着けた。
findings.governingReading: Shirou reaches the stairs on the class 2-A side.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the narrow timing but omits which stairwell he reaches, weakening the route through the school.

findings.highlight: that glaring Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: やる気満々でこっちを睨んでいる遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin glares at him brimming with readiness and intent to continue the fight.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the glare but drops やる気満々, removing her almost eager combat commitment.

findings.highlight: You’re the persistent one! I won’t kill you, so give up already…!
findings.evidenceJa: そっちこそ往生際が悪いっっっ！　命までは取らないんだから大人しくしなさいよね……！
findings.governingReading: Rin retorts that Shirou is the one refusing to accept defeat and orders him to submit quietly because she will not take his life.
findings.explanation: “Persistent” treats both pursuers alike and loses 往生際が悪い’s accusation that Shirou will not admit he has lost.

findings.highlight: it’s more like a machine gun.
findings.evidenceJa: 既に機関銃と同じだった。
findings.governingReading: The uninterrupted wide-area barrage has already become equivalent to a machine gun.
findings.explanation: “More like” leaves a loose comparison where the Japanese declares functional equivalence.

findings.highlight: I swing the stick I “strengthened”.
findings.evidenceJa: ぶん、と景気づけに“強化”した鉄の棒を振ってみる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou gives the Strengthened iron rod an encouraging whoosh of a test swing to psych himself up.
findings.explanation: The English again turns iron into a generic stick and omits both the audible swing and its morale-building purpose.

findings.highlight: I know she’s waiting for me in the hallway,
findings.evidenceJa: ……どうせ廊下で待ち構えているんだろうが
findings.governingReading: Shirou assumes Rin is probably waiting to ambush him in the hallway anyway.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his resigned prediction into stated knowledge.

findings.highlight: crawl into the smoke before me.
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ほふく char=2]匍匐前進で白煙に突入する。
findings.governingReading: Shirou advances into the white smoke in a low military-style crawl, with the reading explicitly supplied.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the specified prone advance to generic crawling and omits the written/reading emphasis.

findings.highlight: And on the other side is…
findings.evidenceJa: そうして焦土を抜けた先に、
findings.governingReading: After passing through the scorched-earth ruin of the classroom, Shirou reaches what waits beyond.
findings.explanation: The English retains only spatial transition and omits the scorched-earth image for Rin’s destruction.

findings.highlight: but I guess that was unnecessary courtesy.
findings.evidenceJa: そんなのはいらないお節介だったみたいね。
findings.governingReading: Rin says her plan to treat him gently was apparently unwanted meddling or solicitude.
findings.explanation: “Courtesy” turns her barbed, care-inflected お節介 into impersonal etiquette.

findings.highlight: I bet she’ll release her Gandr Shot
findings.evidenceJa: その腕からガンドが放たれるのだろう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou predicts Gandr will be released from the arm Rin has raised.
findings.explanation: The English retains the predicted shot but omits its physical origin in the raised arm.
